template.name: user_guided_transport_robot
template.declaration: // Place local declarations here. clock t;

transition.label: robPositionX[R-1] <= location_X[robot_loc_target[R-1]]+30 and robPositionX[R-1] >= location_X[robot_loc_target[R-1]]-30 and robPositionY[R-1] <= location_Y[robot_loc_target[R-1]]+30 and robPositionY[R-1] >= location_Y[robot_loc_target[R-1]]-30
stop_r_moveTo[R-1]!

humanPositionX[human_to_be_followed[R-1]-1] <= location_X[f_loc_target[R-1]]+30 and humanPositionX[human_to_be_followed[R-1]-1] >= location_X[f_loc_target[R-1]]-30 and humanPositionY[human_to_be_followed[R-1]-1] <= location_Y[f_loc_target[R-1]]+30 and humanPositionY[human_to_be_followed[R-1]-1] >= location_Y[f_loc_target[R-1]]-30 and robPositionX[R-1] >= location_X[f_loc_target[R-1]]-30 and robPositionX[R-1] <= location_X[f_loc_target[R-1]]+30 and robPositionY[R-1] >= location_Y[f_loc_target[R-1]]-30 and robPositionY[R-1] <= location_Y[f_loc_target[R-1]]+30
stop_r_follow[R-1]!

Human_moveTo
